meta.name: facts_property
meta.description: 231 (stage D, D-b3): the fact catalogue of property risk assessment, a rule file a case keeps as it started (jav/app/facts.py). It names the levels of what is assessed (the policyholder, its sites, their asset groups), each fact a rule may read with its type, unit or currency, level and allowed codes, and each outcome a rule may give with how the outcomes of several rules combine. Invented for the stage D trial; no insurer's own terms.

changelog.note: 231 (D-f8): the contact person's name and email address, which the request form prints, so the offer's letter addresses them and a person checks them in the data check. Added definitions; no rule reads them and no outcome changes.
231 (D-f4): labels of the cover modules and of the two countries a site may be in, so the data check reads them in words. No fact or outcome changes.

231 (D-e2): the site's address, which the request form and each property schedule print, so a person tells the sites apart and two documents' addresses are compared. An added definition; no rule reads it and no outcome changes.

231 (D-d5): four facts of the policyholder an outside check asks with or answers: its company name and tax number, its status in the company register and whether it is on a sanctions list. Added definitions; no rule reads them yet and no outcome changes.
231 (D-c6): labels, how each level and each code of the options and of the rules' measures and warnings reads to a person (translated by the interface). No outcome changes.

231 (D-c5): interruption_sum_insured, the business interruption cover's sum insured (a year's gross profit or standing costs, by the accounting method), the basis its premium is computed on. An added definition: no earlier outcome changes.
231 (D-b3): the first catalogue: 17 facts on three levels and 7 outcomes.
